about_item: 【Excellent Halloween Decoration】Our 3D bats wall decor are perfect for Halloween Party. They can be pasted both indoors and outdoors, bring some horror atmosphere to the Halloween party. At that time, the fluttering bat stickers will amaze your guests!

【Premium Material】These 3D bats Halloween stickers made of waterproof PVC, removable and reusable. Fit any SMOOTH & DRY surface like cabinets, bookshelf, walls, doors and windows (REMEMBER to CLEAN the dust before using). Do not stick to the vents.

【Package Included】Halloween Decorative Bats Set of 140 scary 3D bats in 5 different sizes: 20Pcs 7.9"x 2", 20Pcs 6.3"x 1.6", 20Pcs 4.7"x 1.2", 60Pcs 3.5"x 0.8", 20Pcs 3.1"x 1.6". Create your "bat cave" "Halloween wreath" with these scary 3D bats for wall, all over the wall or window! Five different sizes of bats are suitable for different scenarios.

【Easy to Use】The package comes with double-sided foam tape. Bats are flat-packed. First, fold the bat wings, then stick the bottom with the provided foam tape, and finally arrange them in the way you like! This is a good project to do with the children. They will like it!
【Easy to Remove】If you want to remove the bat sticker, just heat it up with a hair dryer and you can take it off easily. If there are sticky residues on the wall, they can be wiped off with alcohol.
